_comment: Where the pipelines are installed on the UKDRI cluster. Every skill's scripts/build_job.py
fills the exec= and main= lines of its job script from here (DESIGN.md 2, 4.2), so pointing
the jobs at another Nextflow or a new pipeline checkout is an edit to this file only.
nextflow                -> command to run Nextflow. This can simply be 'nextflow' if it is
installed properly in the environment, or a path to an executable
binary. One command for every pipeline.
pipelines.<id>.main     -> the pipeline's main.nf on the cluster, keyed by each skill's
CONFIG['pipeline_id']. Pinned to the version the skill's assets/
were taken from (DESIGN.md 5): bump both together.
pipelines.<id>.note     -> optional; appended to the main= line as a '# <note>' comment.
A missing or malformed file, or a pipeline with no entry here, is a hard error in build_job.py,
never a silent fallback to some other path.
